plot: On the frosty morning after Dog's birthday Max's water bowl and Bird's bird bath have turned to 'stone' just as Bird's twelve relatives fly in for a drink; scratching the ice only lands Max in the snow, but sitting on his bowl leaves a little puddle, so he learns warm turns ice back into water, and when the group hug is too slow he remembers the drip from the sunny porch roof, they push the bird bath out of the shadow into the sun under the drip, and the whole flock drinks.

beats.say: Hey! My water won't move! Tap, tap... WHOA!
The bowl slides across the ice. And so does Max.
My water turned into STONE! Who did this?!
It's the morning after Dog's birthday. Everything is white and sparkly.
I'm so thirsty. And my water is a rock!
Drip. A cold drop falls from the porch roof onto his nose.
Hey! Why is the roof crying on my nose today?
Max! Help! The bird bath turned to stone too!
And my whole family is flying here for a morning drink!
Your whole family? How many birds is that?
Twelve! My aunties, my cousins, and Grandpa Tweet!
Twelve thirsty birds and zero water. Uh-oh.
Did the water run away in the night?
Maybe it's hiding under the stone. Like a fish.
I'll get it back. Cats are great at opening things!
Max jumps up on the bird bath and scratches the stone water.
Scratch, scratch! Open up, water! Open up!
His paws slip. Max slides off into the snow. Poof!
Ten out of ten for that landing!
Max, you have a snow hat now. A very tall one.
It's not a hat. It's a very cold crown.
My paws are freezing. I'll sit down on my bowl and think.
Max sits right on top of the frozen bowl.
Ooh! Cold seat! Cold seat! Very cold seat!
Max hops up. And then he looks down at the bowl.
There's water on top! A puddle shaped like my bottom!
Real water! Where did it come from?
From the stone! My warm fur made it soft again!
So the stone is just water that got very, very cold?
Yes! Cold makes water hard. Warm makes it water again!
That's right, Max. Hard, cold water is called ice.
Last night was so cold, the water froze.
Froze? Like when I freeze in front of the vacuum?
Then let's make the bird bath warm! Everybody, hug!
Max, Dog and Mouse hug the bird bath. A big warm hug.
Brr. My nose is turning into an ice cube.
I'm big and fluffy. The bird bath loves me.
Slowly, slowly, a tiny puddle melts on top.
One sip! That's enough for one bird. Maybe half a bird.
Half a bird? Which half gets the water?
Then Bird looks up at the sky.
Oh no! There they are! My family is coming!
Twelve little birds fly over the trees toward the garden.
Twelve birds! We can't hug fast enough! We need more warm!
I can't get any fluffier. I already tried.
And my tiny paws only melt a tiny dot.
And then, drip. Another cold drop lands on Max's nose.
The roof again! Wait... why is the roof dripping?
Max looks up. The porch roof is in the bright morning sun.
The sun is melting the snow on the roof!
The sun is warmer than all of us together!
The bird bath stands in the cold blue shadow by the fence.
We put it in the wrong place! Dog, help me push!
Max pushes. Dog pushes. Mouse pushes with her whole tiny body.
The bird bath slides into the sun, right under the drip.
Drip, drip, drip. The sun shines. The ice starts to melt.
Water! Lots of water! Shiny and sparkly!
Just in time. Twelve birds land around the bird bath.
Auntie, Grandpa Tweet, everybody! Drink up!
Grandpa Tweet says it's the best bird bath in town!
Max, you found the warmest spot in the whole garden.
Not me. The sun and the drippy roof found it!
And Max's bottom found the first puddle!
Max pushes his own bowl into the sun, too.
Ahh. Water. The best drink on a cold morning.
And the roof is your water helper. Drip, drip!
Cold turns water into ice. Warm sun turns it back again.
Thank you, Max! My family will come back every morning!
Every morning? Then I'll check the sun every morning!
That evening, Grandma sits by the window and hums a song.
La la la... la la... Oh dear. How does it end?
Grandma forgot the end of her song?
And tomorrow night, someone will need that song very much.

long.title: Max's Water Turned to STONE?! 🧊😹

"I'm so thirsty, and my water turned into a rock!" 🐱
On the first frosty morning Max's bowl and Bird's bird bath are hard as stone, and twelve thirsty birds are on their way. Can Max find out how to bring the water back? Max the Curious Cat, Ep 34.
